selection_policy: reference-aligned override after quantitative and visual audit
role: frozen codec shared by the R0 full-clip control and M6 block-autoregressive treatment

geometry.reference_alignment: matches the public f8t4d16 compression geometry used by Wan/CogVideoX-style causal video codecs; the small DSF codec implementation and training recipe are not reproductions

predeclared_gate_result.override_reason: The project prioritizes a direct reference-geometry starting point before introducing Block-AR. Visual audit found both codecs usable, so f8t4d16 is selected while its measurable fidelity deficit remains disclosed.

claim_limits: This is a deterministic causal video autoencoder in the selected training configuration because KL regularization is disabled.
The codec is lossy and was selected for reference geometry plus acceptable visual fidelity, not because it won the predeclared reconstruction gate.
The f8t2d32 alternative reconstructed this dataset more faithfully and must remain visible in reporting.
R0 and M6 must use these exact checkpoint and latent-statistics hashes.
